head.title: IXL | Math, Language Arts, Science, Social Studies, and Spanish

meta.name: description
meta.content: IXL is the world's most popular subscription-based learning site for K-12. Used by over 18 million students, IXL provides personalized learning in more than 17,000 topics, covering math, language arts, science, social studies, and Spanish.
IXL | Math, Language Arts, Science, Social Studies, and Spanish
IXL is the world's most popular subscription-based learning site for K-12. Interactive questions, awards, and certificates keep kids motivated as they master skills.

iframe.allow: autoplay; fullscreen; gamepad; clipboard-read; clipboard-write; cross-origin-isolated

section.p: IXL is a learning platform focused on skills practice, targeted review, and steady progress tracking for students in K-12 math and language arts.
